name: Wynona Alcaraz
career: Hotel breakfast lounge attendant and banquet setup assistant
bio: Wynona works early mornings at a coastal hotel, refilling pastry trays and quietly arranging banquet rooms before most guests have found the coffee. After work she unwinds with Coastal Carolina football clips, funny hoops drills, Gran Turismo 7 laps, and red-carpet fashion recaps she saves for outfit ideas. She is slowly repainting her apartment with thrifted decor, though half-finished projects often sit beside her small collection of carnivorous plants. On calmer nights, she follows mindfulness prompts and reads about Yellowstone wildlife conservation before bed.
